core_obligations: Local lifting (proof lines 9985-9996): given a surjective map and a section of the pushforward over an object, the author chooses a covering of the image and local lifts, which assemble into a commutative diagram from the coproduct of the representable sheaves of the members into the target.

Enlarging the diagram (proof lines 9997-10011): the assumption provides a covering of the object together with the factorisations needed to enlarge the commutative diagram, which yields sections of the source over the members restricting to the lifted sections, whence the section is locally in the image and the pushforward is surjective.
proof_roadmap: Choose local lifts of a section along a covering of the image.
Use the assumption to enlarge the resulting commutative diagram over a covering of the object.
Conclude that the section is locally in the image.
difficulty_reason: The lemma gives a condition under which the pushforward along a morphism of sites preserves surjections: given a covering of the image of an object, a covering of the object must exist such that the associated map of representable sheaves factors through the given one (statement lines 9966-9982). The proof is a complete argument: a section of the pushforward is locally lifted along a covering of its image, producing a commutative diagram (proof lines 9985-9996); the assumption then provides a covering of the object allowing that diagram to be enlarged (proof lines 9997-10005); and the enlarged diagram exhibits the section as locally in the image, whence surjectivity (proof lines 10006-10011). The non-formal content is the enlargement of the diagram. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
